items.text: Speaker 1: Welcome back to the show. Today we are talking about small city gardens. / Speaker 2: Thanks for having me. I started with three tomato plants on my balcony last spring. / Speaker 1: Three plants? How did they do over the summer? / Speaker 2: Better than I expected. By August we had more tomatoes than we could eat, so I shared them with the neighbors.
